header.description: Target system

Client generated Id to include for tracing requests, so that the API can easily trace the HTTP request all the way from a client to MTNs backend processes (via our proxies). Each time a request is made to an MTN API the client should include a unique request reference in the HTTP Header. The value must be between 5 and 20 characters, and consist of ASCII letters, digits, or the characters. Invalid or blank IDs will be ignored and replaced with generated ones. MTN may use this to detect duplicate transactions from the client, but this functionality is not always guaranteed, so clients must make their own efforts to prevent duplicate transactions. MTN will also log the transactionId in order to assist with debugging and to correlate transactions processed by the API to requests from the client.
